fusions.name: Split-Shale Shaft
fusions.desc: Looses a shale-headed arrow that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. The head splits and leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the damage. You hold 4 arrows; each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Weighted Flight
fusions.desc: Looses 3 heavy stone-headed arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 10 damage and stunning what it hits for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Braced Stance
fusions.desc: You brace your feet for 1.5 seconds, then for 20 seconds your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far.

fusions.name: Flint Bodkins
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour.
